batches.name: batch-1-correctness-and-accessibility
batches.brief: Land low-risk viewer correctness fixes first so later export UX changes build on the right diagnostics and dialog behavior.

acceptance.18: Help dialog no longer reports missing Chromium for the viewer path and instead reflects built-in Electron Chromium support.
acceptance.22: Keyboard focus stays trapped within HelpDialog and OpenUrlDialog, with focus restored to the trigger on close.
acceptance.24: Save PDF performs a fast readiness check before opening the save dialog and surfaces plain-language remediation when export is not ready.

batches.name: batch-2-rendering-and-toolbar-ux
batches.brief: Improve render/export feedback and page navigation once the viewer state model is stable.

acceptance.19: Loading overlay shows live render progress, exposes cancel, and returns to the empty state when the preview is stopped.
acceptance.23: Successful PDF export toast persists for 8 seconds and exposes Show in Folder.
acceptance.20: Toolbar shows a page pill that toggles into inline edit mode for direct navigation; chapter dropdown is deferred unless trivial.

batches.name: batch-3-export-progress-refinement
batches.brief: Build on the existing export pill without regressing issue #17's stability fix.

acceptance.21: Export progress pill announces updates via aria-live and shows elapsed time after 3 seconds; hard cancellation remains subject to implementation feasibility.

notes: True cancellation may require explicit interruption support in the hidden BrowserWindow export path and could be escalated if unsafe.

batches.name: batch-4-source-model-and-opening
batches.brief: Introduce a source model before recents/favorites UX, and hold authenticated URL support until the auth constraints are clear.

acceptance.12: Local folder vs local git folder classification exists with capabilities that the UI can query; managed GitHub support may need a follow-up slice.
acceptance.10: Open-source modal can consolidate open actions, recent locations, and favorites once source metadata exists.
acceptance.11: Authenticated URL support requires product and embedding constraints review before implementation.

notes: #10 depends on the shape introduced by #12.
#11 is the most likely blocked item in this milestone set.

independentReview.verdict: Approve with issue #20 and #21 partially scoped and #11 flagged as blocked pending auth-flow definition.
